Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error in step 5 by incorrectly identifying Archduchess Maria Theresa of Austria as the mother of Archduke Leopold Salvator of Austria. The correct mother, as confirmed by the WebSurfer findings, is Princess Maria Immaculata of Bourbon-Two Sicilies. This misidentification led to confusion in later steps, as the Planner continued to build upon this incorrect information.
